adjudication.rationale: In packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/organizations/create.handler.ts the conditional around setting the organization `slug` was flipped. Previously `slug` was set only when `!IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED` (`...(!IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED && { slug })`), and when billing was enabled it instead stored `requestedSlug` in metadata. After the change it sets `slug` when `IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED` and sets nothing when it’s disabled (`...(IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED ? { slug } : {})`). This means non-billing instances no longer get a slug at creation, and billing-enabled instances now get the live slug immediately (while also still writing `requestedSlug`), matching the reported broken workflow.
